definition: A frame of reference is the spatial system the mind uses to locate events or sensations. In this source, it means representing stimuli either by where they fall on the body itself or by where the body and nearby objects are positioned in external space.

reasons: The definition generalizes “the spatial system the mind uses to locate events or sensations” broadly, but the packet only investigates localization of nociceptive stimuli using (somatotopic vs spatiotopic/peripersonal) frames of reference.
